references.text: The Lord's mighty hand demonstrated through the plagues in Egypt, so that His name would be proclaimed throughout the earth
Israel saw the Lord's mighty hand when He parted the Red Sea, and they feared the Lord
God's mighty works were shown so that the people would know that the Lord is God
The purpose of fearing the Lord every day
Rahab testifies that the peoples had heard about the Lord's mighty works and feared Him
God saved Israel for His name's sake, to make His power known
All the ends of the earth shall see God's salvation
